title: doc-candidates.json
description: What the model proposes after reading a deck or notes ingested by scripts/ingest_docs.py extract, written to <project>/project-context/brand-debug/doc-candidates.json. fields: context.json values, each with the excerpt of the cited page it rests on. proof: positioning.proof objects (definitions.proof_item of context-schema.json) whose source cites the page, e.g. docs/deck.pdf#p7, and whose claim is on that page word for word. ingest_docs.py check refuses the rest; ingest_docs.py apply writes only what the founder approved.

field.description: Dotted path in context.json, e.g. one_liner, icp.who, offer.differentiators.

value.description: Proposed value, in the founder's words where the page has them. A list for icp.pains, icp.jobs, offer.differentiators.

excerpt.description: The words of the page the value rests on, copied exactly.
